external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A company subscribing to the invoicing service; each customer company is one tenant.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Users are either admins or viewers. They authenticate with an email address, password, and session cookie; there is no second factor.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The recipient of an invoice email who can open the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: An agent who works from the support office network and uses the admin console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
external_entities.notes: Each agent signs in with their own account and a one-time code.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared application used by customer users to manage invoices and provide payment pages; it queries the tenant database, enqueues PDF render jobs, and fetches PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: The app performs the company filtering itself. It loads invoices by invoice number, saves every field received from the edit form, and trusts company and role-related controls that are not fully documented.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A worker that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs to the PDF bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
processes.notes: It trusts the company ID carried by each job.

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: A console reachable only from the support office network through which support agents can open billing-app sessions as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: The admin console is reachable only from there
processes.notes: The text does not state where the console runs or how it connects to other components.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column. The app applies the company filter; the database has no row-level security and the app uses one database account for all companies. The source does not state how the database is protected at rest.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue holding PDF render jobs containing a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_stores.notes: The source does not state how the queue is reached or protected at rest.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared cloud bucket storing rendered invoice PDFs under company IDs and invoice numbers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs with one service credential for all companies. The source does not state how the bucket is protected at rest.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: A customer user uses the billing app in a browser to view and modify invoices.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie; no second factor
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer information, payout bank details, and session authentication data

data_flows.name: open payment page
data_flows.description: A payer follows an invoice link and views the payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details
data_flows.notes: The payer is not required to sign in.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, and bank details

data_flows.name: send invoice email
data_flows.description: The billing app sends the payer an email containing an invoice link.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice link containing the invoice number

data_flows.name: read and write invoices
data_flows.description: The billing app queries and updates records in the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app loads invoices by invoice number and saves every field received from the invoice edit form.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, company IDs, paid flags, and user-associated records

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app places a PDF render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: take render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID carried by the job.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice selected using the job's company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a rendered invoice PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF, company ID, and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.notes: The same service credential is used for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDFs

data_flows.name: sign in to admin console
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Admin-console authentication data

data_flows.name: open customer session
data_flows.description: A support agent uses the admin console to open a billing-app session as a customer user and perform actions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Everything the agent does is recorded against the customer user rather than the agent.
data_flows.authentication: customer user session opened from the admin console
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session activity and billing data

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud platform containing the shared billing app, tenant database, render queue, PDF renderer, and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and from which the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

trust_boundaries.name: customer company tenant
trust_boundaries.description: The tenant boundary associated with each customer company and its users.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant
trust_boundaries.notes: The service uses one shared application and database for all companies.
